# Third-party source pins

- Collabora source is a Git submodule pinned to CollaboraOnline/online.mirror commit ec0238c3ff83d2806225765fcccd7a7dc67e5da4.
- The mirror is read-only; upstream development and code review happen on Gerrit.
- Read docs/ENGINE_STRATEGY.md and docs/HINDI_FONT_INTEGRATION.md before changing or building the native engine.
- Do not remove upstream copyright, license notices or third-party license files.
